title: Settings

analytics.toggleBody: Which screens and actions get used. No name, and nothing you write.
analytics.crashNote: Crash reports are always sent so we can fix what breaks. They never carry your name, your email, or anything you write.
analytics.askBody: We'd like to count which screens and actions get used, so we can see what helps and what gets in the way. Never your name, and never anything you write or pray.
analytics.askFootnote: Everything works the same either way, and Settings has the switch whenever you want it. Crash reports are always sent, with your name and your words left out.

profile.title: Profile
profile.usuallyWithin: A leader there usually confirms within 48 hours
profile.staysUntilConfirmed: {{branch}} stays your home branch until they confirm, so your reminders and events do not change yet.
profile.cancelFailed: We could not cancel that just now. Try again in a moment.
profile.errorLoad: We could not load your profile just now. Check your connection and try again.

branchChange.title: Your home branch
branchChange.lead: This sets the services and events you see, and the reminders you get. Pick the branch you actually gather with.
branchChange.confirmedBy: A leader at the branch you join confirms this, usually within 48 hours.
branchChange.confirmBody: A leader at {{branch}} confirms this, usually within 48 hours. Until then {{current}} stays your home branch, so your reminders and events do not change yet.
branchChange.tooSoonBody: You joined {{branch}} on {{date}}. Branch changes settle for 90 days so a branch can get to know you, and so reminders and counts stay steady.
branchChange.errorTooSoon: Branch changes settle for 90 days. Nothing was changed.
branchChange.errorAlreadyAsked: You already have a request waiting. Cancel it first if you want to ask for somewhere else.
branchChange.errorSameBranch: That is already your home branch.
branchChange.errorBranchClosed: That branch is not taking new members just now.
branchChange.errorOffline: You appear to be offline, so nothing was sent. Try again when you are back.
branchChange.errorGeneric: We could not send that just now. Nothing was changed.
branchChange.welcomeBodyAfter: now. Your services, events and reminders follow you here.
branchChange.noteBody: Your request is with the team at {{branch}}.
branchChange.refusedBody: {{branch}} did not approve this move, and we cannot share the reason here. If you would like to talk it through, they are at {{email}}. You are welcome to ask again whenever you are ready.

blocked.title: Blocked members
blocked.subhead: You and these members do not see each other's posts. They are not told.
blocked.unblockFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
blocked.emptyBody: If you ever need to, you can block a member from the post actions menu on their post.

signedOut: Signed out. You can keep browsing.
